LETTER.TITLE: A letter for you
LETTER.INTRO: Tap the envelope. There is something I have wanted to tell you for a while.

PARAGRAPHS.FIFTH: I love all your fascinating conversations and your passion for helping others. I admire your determination, your dream of creating your own foundation, and the way you stand proudly for what you believe in. I am certain you will achieve it and help many children and women, and I would love to be there when your dreams come true. 🫶✨
PARAGRAPHS.SIXTH: I am grateful to destiny, to God, or to whatever allowed us to truly get to know each other at this moment in our lives. I do not know what will happen from today onward, whether you will welcome me into your life in a different way or whether we will remain best friends, but I want you to know that I have developed a fondness for you that I had not felt in a long time. Thank you for this journey, this moment, this place, and the opportunity to share one of the happiest experiences of your life by your side. 💖
PARAGRAPHS.FIRST: Since you came into my life, every moment has taken on a different meaning. I love sharing my days, thoughts, laughter, and all those little things that make being by your side so special.
PARAGRAPHS.SECOND: I want to keep making memories with you, be there on the good days, and stay close when things get difficult.
PARAGRAPHS.THIRD: That is why I made this little letter. It may be a different way to ask, but I wanted it to feel special and made with lots of love.
PARAGRAPHS.FOURTH: Would you like to begin this new story with me? 💖

MEETING.TITLE: The day we met
MEETING.DESCRIPTION: Without knowing it, my favorite part of the story was beginning.
MEETING.DESCRIPTION2: At that moment I did not understand what was happening. I cannot call it love at first sight because we were children and did not yet know what love felt like, but I truly liked you. Your beauty drew me to you from the first day we met, and you were, are, and always will be the first girl I ever liked. 💖
MEETING.DESCRIPTION3: I do not remember every detail of our friendship in elementary school, but I remember always looking for you when we played cops and robbers. It was probably my way of staying close to you while pretending I did not have a crush on you. I also remember the songs and those small moments that kept reminding me of you. 🙈
MEETING.DESCRIPTION4: I loved that we had the same phone and never imagined it was because you liked me too. I remember the Christmas exchange and how carefully I searched for purple things because it was your favorite color. Every little detail felt important because it was for you. ✨
MEETING.DESCRIPTION5: As elementary school came to an end, I promised myself I would tell you how I felt. I finally sent you a text message with trembling hands, but fear won the next day. When you asked whether it was true, I panicked and said it had only been a joke.

DATE.TITLE: Our first date
DATE.DESCRIPTION: After everything that happened in elementary school, we entered middle school in different groups. I still searched for you during every break, and the feelings were still there, along with the regret of having backed away.
DATE.DESCRIPTION2: One day I saw you holding hands with someone else and felt my young heart break. I understood that I had waited too long, even though we were still too young to understand how any of this worked.
DATE.DESCRIPTION3: Later you moved to the United States, but I never completely lost sight of you. I remember wishing you a happy birthday and occasionally seeing you again around town. 😅
DATE.DESCRIPTION4: Whenever I saw you again, even while we were each living our own lives, I always thought: ‘She is still as beautiful as ever.’ It was always a lovely surprise to see you again. 🥰

SPECIAL.TITLE: When I knew you were special
SPECIAL.DESCRIPTION: Now that we have started talking again, I can tell you that beyond how beautiful you are, I love your personality, your thoughts, the way you express yourself, and so many other things about you. ✨
SPECIAL.DESCRIPTION2: I was nervous when I messaged you again. I was on the bus to work when I gathered the courage to invite you out for coffee. 🤭
SPECIAL.DESCRIPTION3: Honestly, I did not expect an answer, but you eventually replied. I loved that you later explained what had happened, and throughout these months I have deeply appreciated the emotional intelligence you have shown me. 💖
SPECIAL.DESCRIPTION4: I love our late-night conversations, the photos you send when you feel beautiful, and hearing about your days. You can completely change my day with a single message. I LIKE YOU SO MUCH, AND I WILL NEVER GET TIRED OF SAYING IT! ✨

FINAL.MESSAGE: Thank you for coming into my life. I hope this is only the first page of a beautiful story. 🐻💖🐻
